checks.source: 你最想把哪個不好解釋的問題畫成動畫，留言告訴我。
checks.reason: Acceptable compact CTA Korean with a formal imperative. 설명 힘든 explicitly keeps difficulty explaining; 애니화 1순위 identifies the topic the viewer most wants animated; 댓글로 주십시오 preserves the request for a comment. 문제 is naturally implicit in this caption-length object phrase and its immediate practice context. corrections.after: AI 교육 애니메이션도 글자·숫자 수정이 됩니다.
corrections.reason: The source says viewers can edit text and numbers in the resulting animation. The present subject plus 고칩니다 instead says the animation itself corrects text and numbers. Express editing capability. Suggested text is 27/28 characters.

corrections.before: 가장 애니로 풀고픈 난제, 댓글로 주십시오.
corrections.after: 설명 힘든 애니화 1순위, 댓글로 주십시오.
corrections.reason: 난제 alone describes a hard problem and drops the source restriction that the problem is hard to explain. Keep explanation difficulty explicit, use 1순위 for the animation the viewer most wants, and retain the invitation to comment. Suggested text is 24/24 characters.

corrections.before: Video ini hanya menjawab mengapa peluang jumlah dadu berbeda.
corrections.after: Video hanya menjawab mengapa peluang total mata dadu berbeda.
corrections.reason: Meaning: Jumlah dadu can mean the number of dice; the source specifically discusses probabilities of sums of dice pips. Say total mata dadu and retain hanya.

corrections.before: Baca judul, target dari data, bukan angka per gambar.
corrections.after: Baca judul, target dari data; jangan hardcode angka.
corrections.reason: Meaning: Bukan angka per gambar attaches to what is read and loses the instruction against writing a separate set of fixed numbers in each image. Restore the prohibition on hardcoding.

corrections.before: Target baru mengubah letak sel menyala; hitungan samping wajib ikut.
corrections.after: Target baru: sel menyala berganti, angka samping wajib diperbarui.
corrections.reason: Meaning: Mengubah letak sel menyala can imply moving the grid cells physically. The result changes which cells are highlighted, while the adjacent count updates too.

corrections.before: Usai ganti bahasa, dengar durasi narasi asli, baru atur durasi gambar.
corrections.after: Usai ganti bahasa, dengar durasi narasi jadi, baru atur lama gambar.
corrections.reason: Meaning: Narasi asli can be read as the original/source-language narration. The source requires listening to the actual finished narration after changing language before setting picture duration.

corrections.before: Mau animasikan soal sulit apa? Beri komentar.
corrections.after: Soal apa sukar dijelaskan? Mau animasi? Komentar.
corrections.reason: Meaning: Soal sulit says the problem is difficult, whereas 不好解釋 says it is difficult to explain. Restore the explanatory difficulty while retaining animation and the request for comments within 49 codepoints.

corrections.before: 1+6 dan 6+1 dihitung terpisah: hasil kedua dadu berurutan.
corrections.after: 1+6 dan 6+1 dihitung terpisah: urutan hasil dadu penting.
corrections.reason: Glossary: Hasil kedua dadu berurutan can suggest successive events in time. The mathematical condition is that the order/identity of the two dice results matters; keep both numeric examples.

corrections.before: Tulis prompt: gambar semua hasil berurutan dari dua dadu adil.
corrections.after: Prompt: gambar semua pasangan berurutan dari dua dadu adil.
corrections.reason: Glossary: Semua hasil berurutan suggests a sequence of results. Pasangan berurutan is the standard mathematical term for ordered pairs; keep all outcomes and the two fair dice.

corrections.before: Kamu ingin membetulkan salah ketik, bukan mengundi gambar bagus lagi.
corrections.after: Bukan mengundi gambar bagus lagi; kamu mau betul-betul membetulkan salah ketik.
corrections.reason: Cue order: The source and SRT state not obtaining another nice image before actually correcting the typo. Current text reverses the two contrast clauses; restore their order and the emphasis on actually fixing it.

corrections.before: Linimasa munculkan fokus satu per satu, bukan jejalkan semua gambar.
corrections.after: Linimasa bukan menjejali semua gambar; fokus muncul satu per satu.
corrections.reason: Cue order: The source first rejects cramming all images together, then introduces points appearing one by one. Current text puts the positive clause first. Preserve the contrast order.

corrections.before: Syarat tak didukung: hentikan dan jelaskan, jangan diam-diam ganti soal.
corrections.after: Syarat tak didukung: jelaskan lalu berhenti, jangan diam-diam ganti soal.
corrections.reason: Cue order: The source says explain the reason and then stop. Current text says stop and explain, reversing the instruction sequence.

corrections.before: Hanya baca data untuk cek; sumber tetap. Parameter jumlah sel harapan, lanjut jika cocok.
corrections.after: Cek data tanpa mengubah sumber; parameter: jumlah sel yang diharapkan. Lanjut jika cocok.
corrections.reason: Readability: Jumlah sel harapan is unnatural here and can be mistaken for a probabilistic expected value. Explicitly name the expected cell count while retaining read-only behavior and the only-proceed-if-correct condition.

corrections.before: Cek awal dan akhir agar tak terpotong atau menyisakan ekor kosong.
corrections.after: Cek awal dan akhir agar tak terpotong atau ada sisa bagian kosong.
corrections.reason: Readability: Ekor kosong is a literal calque of the Chinese tail metaphor and is unnatural for a video ending. Say leftover blank section while retaining both the cut-off and blank-ending checks.
